states: Compiled Pulse Settings with the existing Audit Log panel, real client and a loopback synthetic session, two audit events and explicit signature verification.
Playwright 1.56.1 matches the integration lock; Chromium 141.0.7390.37. Desktop light and 390 px dark touch emulation, matched scroll and data.
19 journeys and 25 native-inspected captures (11 comparison pairs) include loading, storage busy, access refusal, matched expanded/collapsed mobile results and clear/recovery.
interactions: Start with an admitted page and working signature check. Typing triggers a debounced read. Search, focus and the selected mobile disclosure stay in place through same-reader loading and a 503 while rows, verification and totals are withdrawn.

Clear filters makes one fresh unfiltered read; only the current rows and unchecked status return. A 403 still withdraws the filter bar and audit page. A successful filtered read preserves focus without changing the result or the disclosure layout.

Type into a held read without refocusing: the obsolete request is canceled, its late rows do not appear, and the last query gets the only new result. Fixture requests are bound reads with a synthetic session and no API-token or write.
